sloka: अस्मिन् विनिहते पापे राक्षसे रणमूर्धनि।रावणं वर्जयित्वा तु शेषमस्य हतं बलम् ।। ६.९०.९ ।।
transliteration: asmin vinihate pāpe rākṣase raṇamūrdhani।rāvaṇaṁ varjayitvā tu śeṣamasya hataṁ balam ।। 6.90.9 ।।

translations.english: "If this wicked Rakshasa is struck down, except Ravana all his army is killed."
